0022600027.text: The 76ers (8-1, first in the Atlantic and the East, on a five-game winning streak) visit the Cavaliers (4-4, sixth in the East and two games back in the Central), who have lost their last two. Philadelphia leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 114-106 win in Philadelphia on October 22, and it also lost all four meetings in 2025-26. Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Barlow (back, fracture) are out for Philadelphia, with Bona day-to-day for a head injury and a game-time decision, while Cleveland is without Tyson (ankle sprain) and Watson (hamstring soreness), with Allen (knee) and Proctor (ankle) day-to-day and game-time decisions.
